title: Generalize Gf2mElement storage beyond u64 to support m=64+
description:
Currently `Gf2mElement` uses `u64` storage via the `UintExt` sealed trait, which caps field size at m=63 (the primitive polynomial for m=64 has a leading bit at position 64, which doesn't fit in `u64`). This limits GF(2^m) operations to fields smaller than GF(2^64).

## Goal

Extend `Gf2mElement_<V: UintExt>` to support `u128` (and potentially wider) storage, enabling GF(2^64) through GF(2^127).

## Scope

- Add `UintExt` impl for `u128`
- Ensure `BarrettReducer` works for m=64+ (it already uses `u128` internally, but verify edge cases)
- Update `primitive_polys.rs` with standard primitive polynomials for m=64
- Update benchmarks in `gf2m_mul_strategies.rs` to include true GF(2^64) once supported
- Verify PCLMULQDQ kernels handle the wider storage correctly (the intrinsic produces 128-bit output, so m=64 fits naturally)

## Success criteria

- `Gf2mElement_<u128>` passes the same field axiom tests as `Gf2mElement_<u64>`
- GF(2^64) multiplication produces correct results verified against known test vectors
- Benchmarks updated to include GF(2^64) alongside GF(2^63) for comparison
